featured_reviews.review_text:
Shri Gajanan Motor Training School is fine for learning the absolute basics, but the training is incomplete. They strictly keep you in 1st and 2nd gear, which doesn't prepare you for actual road conditions.
Once I started driving on my own, I realized I hadn't been taught how to downshift from 4th or 5th gear or how to accelerate smoothly on a slope without jerking the car. If you want to be a confident driver, you’ll likely need extra practice beyond their curriculum to handle higher speeds and inclines.
Pros: Decent for basic car control.
Cons: No high-gear training, lacks instruction on downshifting and slope management.

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Valivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Driving Class is situated at Lower Parel, opposite Kamala Mills compound.

Charges - 7500 for 22 days + 4000 for license from RTO. Separate charges for using AC (in case the vehicle you practice on has AC option).

They have off on Thursdays. So no class.

The Theory lectures are conducted on alternate Sundays - 10-12 AM.

I took training for Ertiga, from Rakesh Master and is very professional, patient, a good teacher.

Learners license :
1. There is RTO exam application to practice questions with time option, so before going for exam you want to practice the questions.
2. In case you fail, you may re-appear for the test again one week after that date.
3. RTO charges 100 as fine for reappearing learners test.
4. There are 15 questions out of which 9 is passing.

Overall it has been a very good experience at Excellent Driving School. Very well trained Teachers / Driving masters. Responsive staff.  I have personally extended my period of class to get good hands on experience before driving test.

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Chawande
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today we finished the bike training course and would like to share my experience.
The training was very well structured and covered all the essential aspects required to become a confident rider:

✅ Balance & Control
✅ Clutch ⚙️ & Gear Shifting
✅ Braking 🛑 & Turns ↩️
✅ Speed Breaker Practice ⛰️
✅ Slope Training ⬆️⬇️
✅ Square Training ◻️
✅ Traffic Riding 🚦

What stood out the most was Sachiii’s (Trainer) patience and professionalism. There were moments during the course when I panicked and even dropped the bike 🙈, including in the final session. Each time, Sachiii handled the situation calmly, reassured me, and guided me step by step until I regained control 💪.

Throughout these training days, Sachiii consistently boosted my morale, provided clear instructions, and offered point-by-point feedback that made learning easy and effective. Her encouragement and approach made me feel confident and motivated at every stage of the training.

Thanks to this course and Sachiii’s guidance, I now feel fully prepared to ride independently and safely. Overall, it was an excellent learning experience, and I truly appreciate Sachiii’s dedication, patience, and support 👏🔥.

I would also like to Thank all Women on Wheels  team members for going out of the way and arranging the training sessions 🫰🏻🫱🏻‍🫲🏻

I am truly grateful for making me eligible to pursue the dream of riding a motorcycle in a such a short time🫱🏻‍🫲🏻🤜🏻🤛🏻.
